description: unional baseline, inlined: single updater, GitHub-native automerge, release-age soak. Mirrors apply-repo-baseline's canonical preset until github>unional/renovate-preset carries it.

packageRules.description: type-plus 8.x is an in-progress major rewrite published only on the `beta` tag; `latest` is 7.6.2. `ignoreUnstable` only blocks stable-to-unstable, so once a prerelease is pinned every new beta reads as a patch and automerges. Pin the line to <8.0.0 until the 8.x promotion is an explicit owner decision.
